subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Many recognized sounds they had ignored for years.”?
options: One student said the market recording made him feel hungry.
A student said the birds made the world feel connected.
A student with allergies said clear labels made her feel safer.
A student with a medical condition said this made travel difficult.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Many recognized sounds they had ignored for years. One student said the market recording made him feel hungry.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A student said the birds made the world feel connected.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A student with allergies said clear labels made her feel safer.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A student with a medical condition said this made travel difficult.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Many recognized sounds they had ignored for years. One student said the market recording made him feel hungry.」，答案為「One student said the market recording made him feel hungry.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「One student said the market recording made him feel hungry.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
